Hello, family

Welcome to Our Wedding

Thank you for spending this special week with us and for being part of both our family retreat and our wedding celebration. We're incredibly grateful to share these memories with the people who have supported us throughout our journey.

This website is your guide to the retreat, our wedding day, the week's schedule, and a shared space for photos, videos, songs and messages.

With love,
Alex, Michelle & Brianna

Every family has a story

Ours began with one simple date.

April 2022

We Met

We met through online dating while Michelle lived in London and Alex lived in Hamilton. Even with the distance, our first date felt effortless. Conversation came naturally, laughter came easily, and we both knew there was something worth pursuing.

Building a life

Adventure & Home

Our weekends were filled with hiking, backcountry camping and exploring waterfalls. We later moved into a rental in Niagara Falls before purchasing our family home in Fonthill.

On our first night, we ate dinner in lawn chairs around a folding table and slept on an air mattress in the living room. Home was never about the furniture. It was about being together.

Growing our family

Baby Jewell

Finding out we were expecting changed every plan, dream and adventure in the best possible way. We began imagining the future we wanted to create for our daughter.

February 1, 2025

A Surprise Proposal

Michelle thought we were heading out for another winter hike. Nine months pregnant, she carefully followed an icy trail through Short Hills Provincial Park toward Terrace Creek Falls.

When we reached the frozen waterfall, Alex asked Michelle to marry him. She had absolutely no idea it was coming.

February 18, 2025

Our Greatest Adventure

Brianna entered our lives and changed everything. Becoming parents has taught us to slow down, put family first and appreciate the little moments: random kitchen dances, evening walks, big hugs and watching her discover the world.

Now we can't wait for the day she's old enough to join our board game nights.

FAQ

Where should we park at the retreat?

Parking is in the driveway only. Please park closely, leave room for others and be prepared to move vehicles when someone needs to leave.

What should we bring?

Swimsuits, yard games, snacks and properly fitted life jackets for young children.

When will we get the Wi-Fi password?

The Wi-Fi details will be provided when everyone arrives.
